final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS count_val FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(count_val) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts), kept AS (SELECT rc.count_val FROM rating_counts rc, avg_calc ac WHERE rc.count_val > ac.avg_count) SELECT SUM(count_val), AVG(count_val - (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_calc)) FROM kept
